limitations: Only MPEG-1 Layer III has registered conformance evidence
MPEG-2 and MPEG-2.5 are not registered
Only mapping family 0, mono or stereo, zero gain and native 48 kHz decoder output in supported MP4 timelines
Matroska and other mapping families are not registered
Conversions require their own exact registration
Compatible within decode tolerance, never exact-output or ISO conformance eligibility
Only opt-in aac builds, mono/stereo LC, native rate and channels, nonfragmented registered MP4 timelines
PNS requires separable bands with per-band energy within 0.1 dB; deterministic non-PNS projections retain the F32 and S16 sample bounds
Complete PNS-containing PCM is not compared pointwise across decoders; each serialized S16 output is checked against its own F32 output
TNS intersecting PNS, M/S-correlated PNS, intensity sourced from PNS, coupling in PNS streams and all-ones M/S intensity refuse before output
Sample count, priming and timeline remain exact
At most 16384 packets and 64 MiB of encoded audio per pass
